papers.title: IdeaAMBIG: Benchmarking Implementation-Critical Gaps in Research-Idea Specifications

summary.tldr: Researchers introduce IdeaAMBIG, a 660-instance benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on detecting and resolving implementation-critical specification gaps in research methods.
key_points: IdeaAMBIG consists of 660 evidence-grounded instances, comprising 163 real-world gaps from GitHub issues and reproducibility reports, alongside 497 controlled synthetic gaps.
The benchmark evaluates three tasks: codification-readiness assessment, defect localization (given only the specification), and clarification action generation (given the annotated defect).

Across 13 evaluated LLMs, top performance reached only a 9.6% Macro Defect Recovery Rate on real-world instances, but achieved an 80.6% Macro Clarification Action Success Rate when defects were pre-identified.
An oracle study demonstrated that providing gold resolutions increased downstream codification-ready rates from 14% to 98%, highlighting defect localization as the main bottleneck.
summary.why_it_matters: Identifying methodological gaps in research papers is currently the primary failure point preventing autonomous coding agents from successfully reproducing scientific codebases.

papers.title: ActReview: Rebuttal-Guided Training Data and Rubric Rewards for Actionable Peer Review Generation

summary.tldr: ActReview is a rebuttal-guided post-training framework that uses review-rebuttal threads to train models to generate actionable peer reviews consisting of diagnostic claims and grounded revision suggestions.
key_points: Deconstructs actionable peer-review generation into diagnostic claim generation and revision suggestion generation.
Constructs ActReview-40K from OpenReview threads by mapping reviewer concerns to author rebuttals and paper-localized evidence.
Post-trains Qwen3-8B-Base via multi-task supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using candidate-aware, weakness-specific rubric rewards.
Introduces ActReview-Bench, a human-curated benchmark of 1,000 instances designed to evaluate diagnostic quality and revision usefulness.
summary.why_it_matters: Using author rebuttals as latent supervision enables LLMs to generate more actionable, evidence-grounded revision feedback for pre-submission paper refinement.

papers.title: The Semantic Bottleneck: Leveraging Semantic Representations for Non-Invasive Speech Decoding

summary.tldr: Brain2Semantics2Text introduces a non-invasive speech decoding method that maps sentence-level MEG signals into an intermediate semantic embedding space before converting them into natural language text.
key_points: Leverages a semantic bottleneck to reconstruct high-level sentence meaning without requiring word-level temporal alignment.
Maps sentence-level MEG responses directly into a continuous semantic manifold, which is then inverted to generate text.
Targets high-level semantic representations rather than low-level acoustic or lexical features to handle the low signal-to-noise ratio of non-invasive neural recordings.
Demonstrates improved sentence-level text reconstruction performance compared to prior non-invasive Brain2Text approaches.
summary.why_it_matters: Focusing on slower-evolving semantic representations allows non-invasive neural interfaces to overcome low signal-to-noise ratios and decode meaningful continuous text from MEG recordings.

papers.title: PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving

summary.tldr: PlannerForge is a unified LLM-agent framework covering the end-to-end scenario-based testing pipeline for autonomous driving motion planners, including generation, retrieval, modification, assessment, enhancement, and benchmarking.
key_points: Outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 by generating 193 executable scenarios out of 200 from natural language queries, realizing 92-96% of specified road, city, and vehicle attributes.
Beats BM25 on rank-1 scenario selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and exceeds From-Words-to-Collisions on physically valid scenario edits (>=94% vs. 31%).
Open-source 20-35B parameter backends like Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three out of five tasks, with end-to-end module chaining retaining 78-83% of seed queries.
Cost-tuning at N=400 improves planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and decreases collision rates from 19.0% to 8.4% without requiring domain-specific fine-tuning.
summary.why_it_matters: It replaces fragmented, multi-tool testing workflows with a unified, automated LLM framework that improves planner safety without domain-specific model fine-tuning.

papers.title: Reference-Based Bias Detection in LLMs via Relative Representations of Hidden States

summary.tldr: A reference-based auditing method measures Representational Bias Shift (ΔB) in LLM hidden states via relative representations against anchor sentences, detecting internal bias changes without needing generated text or judge models.
key_points: Encodes sentences via similarities to fixed anchor sentences, allowing direct comparison of hidden-state geometries before and after fine-tuning.
Correlates with output-level bias shifts in 15 of 18 tested settings, achieving up to |r| = 0.84 (p < 0.001) under full fine-tuning.
Detects checkpoints with increased bias at ROC AUCs between 0.65 and 0.99, outperforming a SEAT-based baseline on WildGuardMix and DecodingTrust.
Completes an audit in approximately three minutes, consuming 3x to 50x less compute than traditional output-level benchmarks.
summary.why_it_matters: It enables fast, low-compute auditing of fine-tuned model checkpoints for bias shifts without relying on expensive text generation or task-specific evaluation datasets.

infra.title: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store introduces UpdateRecord for feature-level writes

summary.tldr: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store has released the UpdateRecord API, enabling atomic feature-level writes without needing a full read-modify-write cycle using PutRecord.
key_points: Eliminates read-modify-write cycles by accepting up to 100 partial feature updates in a single API call while preserving non-included features.
Supports both Standard (DynamoDB-backed) and In-Memory (ElastiCache-backed) online store tiers.
Requires the target record to already exist (no upsert) and automatically replicates a full record snapshot to the offline store.
Prevents lost-update race conditions and reduces Read Capacity Unit (RCU) charges by bypassing GetRecord calls.
Validates EventTime ordering to reject stale writes; updating EventTime requires a timestamp strictly newer than the existing record value.
summary.why_it_matters: This feature reduces update latency, eliminates race conditions from concurrent pipeline writes, and lowers operational costs by removing prerequisite read requests.
